decisions.topic: Use annotation subjects as an issue inventory, not the whole feature denominator
decisions.decision: Retain the numbered crosswalk but supplement it with content/title/reply and unnumbered-note reconciliation. Literal references or generic numeric markers do not establish disposition.
Preserve the normative-reference interpretation constraint and the two formatting/numbering notes in audit evidence. Do not invent new implementation rows solely because these notes are unnumbered.
